accessPolicy: RUNTIME-PRIVATE: never readable by runtime agents, their tools, the context compiler, runbooks, routes, the UI or builder evaluation code. Only the verifier harness reads it. See README.md.
missionGoal: Investigate the checkout service and restore normal operation if anything is wrong. Acceptance: a fresh order succeeds, inventory stays consistent and health stays ok.
missionConstraints: Change checkout configuration only through proposed actions.
Do not change anything that the evidence does not show is broken.

stepSemantics.pre_start: applied by the verifier through the injector (advanceConfig, actor injector) after the stack is seeded and before POST /missions/:id/start
stepSemantics.on_action_proposed: fires delayMs after NOTIFY nemodots_action_proposed whose payload names key (the injector LISTEN path)
stepSemantics.after_first_commit: fires delayMs after the first action.committed event of the mission
stepSemantics.after_first_admitted: fires delayMs after the first action.decided(admitted) event of the mission
stepSemantics.requiresStaleBlobs: the injector seeds Redis blobs of an older schema under the injected namespace before switching (F1 mechanics are the injector's; the oracle only checks outcomes)
stepSemantics.pre_trial: the value of the key read by the verifier role immediately before the first step of the trial
stepSemantics.invalidTrial: if an injected value equals the pre-trial value the trial is BLOCKED (not scored), never silently passed
